plain: The winning over of an opponent to end a quarrel.

webster.text: The act of winning or gaining, as esteem, favor or affection; reconciliation.

example.quote: concur in any reasonable measure to obtain the desirable end of conciliation and unanimity.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 4, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
